newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Sunway, Worldwide to buy Australia theme park.
newsitem.headline: Sunway, Worldwide to buy Australia theme park.

text.p: Malaysian property firms Sunway City Bhd and Worldwide Holdings Bhd said on Monday that their associate companies have proposed to buy an Australian theme park in Minchinbury, Sydney, for A$50 million.
In separate statements, the companies said the planned acquisition of the Wonderland park and its operator, Sydney Theme Park Pty Ltd, would be from four vendors.
They are Australia's Leighton Holdings Ltd, James Hardie Industries Ltd and State Authorities Superannuation Board and U.S.'s Jacor Communications Co.
The theme park is situated on 218.8 hectares of freehold land on the western suburbs of Sydney.
The proposed acquisition is subject to approval from relevant authorities in Australia and Malaysia.
